#Functions
```{r}
load_data <- function(file, group, protein_col, group_col = "Protein") {
  df <- read.csv(file)
  df$Group <- group
  df$mokapot_qvalue <- if ("mokapot.q.value" %in% names(df)) df$mokapot.q.value else df$mokapot_qvalue
  df
}

summarise_psms <- function(df, protein_col, protein_filter, fdr_thresholds = c(0.01, 0.05),
                            count_fn = n, peptide_col = NULL) {
  map_dfr(fdr_thresholds, function(fdr) {
    df %>%
      filter(grepl(protein_filter, .data[[protein_col]])) %>%
      filter(!grepl("rev", .data[[protein_col]])) %>%
      filter(mokapot_qvalue <= fdr) %>%
      group_by(Group, Replicate) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        n_PSMs = if (is.null(peptide_col)) n() else n_distinct(.data[[peptide_col]]),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(FDR = paste0(fdr * 100, "% FDR"))
  })
}

build_psm_plot <- function(psm_long, y_label = "Number of PSMs", title = "title") {
  psm_summary <- psm_long %>%
    group_by(Score_Method, FDR_Level) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_PSMs = mean(n_PSMs), .groups = "drop")

  percent_increase <- psm_summary %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Score_Method, values_from = mean_PSMs) %>%
    mutate(
      pct_increase = (Rescore - Hyperscore) / Hyperscore * 100,
      label = paste0("+", round(pct_increase, 1), "%")
    )

  ggplot() +
    geom_col(
      data     = psm_summary,
      aes(x = FDR_Level, y = mean_PSMs, fill = Score_Method),
      colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.6,
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = psm_long,
      aes(x = FDR_Level, y = n_PSMs, group = interaction(Replicate, Score_Method)),
      size = 1, colour = "black",
      position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.7)
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = percent_increase,
      aes(x = FDR_Level, y = pmax(Rescore, Hyperscore) * 1.10, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, fontface = "bold", size = 4
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = psm_summary,
      aes(x = FDR_Level, y = mean_PSMs,
          label = scales::comma(round(mean_PSMs)), group = Score_Method),
      vjust = -0.5, fontface = "bold", size = 3,
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Hyperscore" = "#66C2A5", "Rescore" = "#E5C494"), name = "Score Type") +
    labs(x = "FDR Level", y = y_label, title = title) +
    theme_foundation(base_size = base_size, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      panel.grid   = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_blank(),
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold",
                                     size = rel(1), hjust = 0.5),
      text         = element_text(colour = "black"),
      axis.line    = element_line(colour = "black", size = line_size),
      axis.ticks   = element_line(colour = "black", size = line_size),
      axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 2),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text    = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.text  = element_text(colour = "black"),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey80"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

make_qvalue_plot <- function(df, group_label) {
  
  n_target_total <- sum(df$PSM_Type == "Target")
  n_decoy_total  <- sum(df$PSM_Type == "Decoy")
  n_target_1pct  <- sum(df$PSM_Type == "Target" & df$mokapot_qvalue <= 0.01)
  n_decoy_1pct   <- sum(df$PSM_Type == "Decoy"  & df$mokapot_qvalue <= 0.01)
  n_target_5pct  <- sum(df$PSM_Type == "Target" & df$mokapot_qvalue <= 0.05)
  n_decoy_5pct   <- sum(df$PSM_Type == "Decoy"  & df$mokapot_qvalue <= 0.05)
  
  annotation_text <- paste0(
    "Total:  Target = ", scales::comma(n_target_total), "  |  Decoy = ", scales::comma(n_decoy_total), "\n",
    "1% FDR: Target = ", scales::comma(n_target_1pct),  "  |  Decoy = ", scales::comma(n_decoy_1pct),  "\n",
    "5% FDR: Target = ", scales::comma(n_target_5pct),  "  |  Decoy = ", scales::comma(n_decoy_5pct)
  )
  
  df %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = mokapot_qvalue, fill = PSM_Type, colour = PSM_Type)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.8, adjust = 1.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.01, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.7) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = Inf, label = "1% FDR", hjust = -0.1, vjust = 2,
             size = 3.5, colour = "grey30", fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = 0.05, y = Inf, label = "5% FDR", hjust = -0.1, vjust = 2,
             size = 3.5, colour = "grey30", fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("label", x = 0.5, y = Inf, label = annotation_text,
             hjust = 1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.2, colour = "black",
             fill = "white", family = "mono") +
    scale_fill_manual(values   = c("Decoy" = "#E87B3E", "Target" = "#4472C4"), name = NULL) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Decoy" = "#E87B3E", "Target" = "#4472C4"), name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.5), labels = scales::label_number(), expand = c(0,0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(title = group_label, x = "Mokapot Q-value", y = "Density") +
    theme_foundation(base_size = base_size, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major     = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor     = element_blank(),
      panel.border         = element_blank(),
      panel.background     = element_blank(),
      text                 = element_text(colour = "black"),
      plot.title           = element_text(face = "bold",
                               size = rel((title_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size), hjust = 0.5),
      axis.line            = element_line(colour = "black", size = line_size),
      axis.ticks           = element_line(colour = "black", size = line_size),
      axis.title           = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1)),
      axis.title.y         = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 2),
      axis.title.x         = element_text(vjust = -0.2),
      axis.text            = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black"),
      legend.title         = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.text          = element_text(size = rel((axis_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size), colour = "black"),
      legend.background    = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey80"),
      plot.background      = element_blank(),
      legend.position      = c(0.95, 0.6),
      legend.justification = c(1, 1)
    )
}


get_exclusive_peptides <- function(data_rescore, data_hyperscore,
                                    protein_col_rescore    = "Protein",
                                    protein_col_hyperscore = "Proteins",
                                    peptide_col            = "Peptide",
                                    protein_filter         = PROTEIN_FILTER,
                                    fdr                    = 0.05) {
  
  peptides_rescore <- data_rescore %>%
    filter(grepl(protein_filter, .data[[protein_col_rescore]])) %>%
    filter(!grepl("rev", .data[[protein_col_rescore]])) %>%
    filter(mokapot_qvalue <= fdr) %>%
    pull(.data[[peptide_col]]) %>%
    unique()
  
  peptides_hyperscore <- data_hyperscore %>%
    filter(grepl(protein_filter, .data[[protein_col_hyperscore]])) %>%
    filter(!grepl("rev", .data[[protein_col_hyperscore]])) %>%
    filter(mokapot_qvalue <= fdr) %>%
    pull(.data[[peptide_col]]) %>%
    unique()
  
  exclusive <- setdiff(peptides_rescore, peptides_hyperscore)
  
  # Return full rows from rescore for those peptides, with best q-value per peptide
  data_rescore %>%
    filter(.data[[peptide_col]] %in% exclusive) %>%
    filter(grepl(protein_filter, .data[[protein_col_rescore]])) %>%
    filter(!grepl("rev", .data[[protein_col_rescore]])) %>%
    group_by(.data[[peptide_col]]) %>%
    slice_min(mokapot_qvalue, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(mokapot_qvalue) %>%
    filter(grepl("84.", Assigned.Modifications))

}



```


#Load AETMA data
```{r}
data_perc <- load_data("combined_mokapot.csv", group = "Hyperscore", protein_col = "Proteins") %>%
  mutate(
    PSM_Type  = ifelse(grepl("rev_", Proteins), "Decoy", "Target"),
    Replicate = case_when(
      grepl("A1", source_file) ~ 1, grepl("A2", source_file) ~ 2,
      grepl("A3", source_file) ~ 3, grepl("A4", source_file) ~ 4,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    Peptide = Peptide %>%
      str_remove("^[A-Z-]\\.") %>% str_remove("\\d+\\.[A-Z-]$") %>%
      str_remove_all("\\[.*?\\]") %>% str_remove("^n")
  )

data_perc <- data_perc %>%
  mutate(Peptide = Peptide %>%
    str_remove("^n") %>%   # remove leading lowercase n
    str_remove("c$")       # remove trailing lowercase c
  )

data <- read.csv("rescoring_results_AETMA_10ppm_final.csv")
data$Group <- "Rescore"

# ── Build plots — change "AGH" to any protein filter you want ─────────────────

PROTEIN_FILTER <- "AGH"   # <-- only thing you need to change

psm_long_all <- bind_rows(
  summarise_psms(data,      protein_col = "Protein",  protein_filter = PROTEIN_FILTER),
  summarise_psms(data_perc, protein_col = "Proteins", protein_filter = PROTEIN_FILTER)
) %>% dplyr::rename(Score_Method = Group, FDR_Level = FDR)

psm_long_unique <- bind_rows(
  summarise_psms(data,      "Protein",  PROTEIN_FILTER, peptide_col = "Peptide"),
  summarise_psms(data_perc, "Proteins", PROTEIN_FILTER, peptide_col = "Peptide")
) %>% dplyr::rename(Score_Method = Group, FDR_Level = FDR)



# ── Usage ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

exclusive_peptides_1pct <- get_exclusive_peptides(data, data_perc, protein_filter = "AGH")

# Quick summary
cat("Peptides exclusive to Rescore at 5% FDR:", nrow(exclusive_peptides_1pct), "\n")
```

#ROC decoy seperatio
```{r}
data <- read.csv("rescoring_results_AETMA_10ppm_final.csv")
data$Group <- "Rescore"

# ── Parameters ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
base_size          <- 12
axis_text_rel_size <- 2
title_text_rel_size <- 2
line_size          <- 0.5

# ── 1. Summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
summary_table <- data %>%
  group_by(PSM_Type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = n(),
    across(c(Rescore, Hyperscore),
           list(
             mean   = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
             median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
             sd     = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
             min    = ~min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
             max    = ~max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
           ),
           .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(summary_table)


# ── Separation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
separation <- summary_table %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Rescore_median_diff =
      Rescore_median[PSM_Type=="Target"] - Rescore_median[PSM_Type=="Decoy"],
    Hyperscore_median_diff =
      Hyperscore_median[PSM_Type=="Target"] - Hyperscore_median[PSM_Type=="Decoy"],

    Rescore_mean_diff =
      Rescore_mean[PSM_Type=="Target"] - Rescore_mean[PSM_Type=="Decoy"],
    Hyperscore_mean_diff =
      Hyperscore_mean[PSM_Type=="Target"] - Hyperscore_mean[PSM_Type=="Decoy"]
  )

print(separation)

# ── AUCs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
auc_rescore <- roc(data$PSM_Type, data$Rescore,
                   levels=c("Decoy","Target"), direction="<")$auc

auc_hyperscore <- roc(data$PSM_Type, data$Hyperscore,
                      levels=c("Decoy","Target"), direction="<")$auc


# ── ROC curves ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
roc_rescore <- roc(data$PSM_Type, data$Rescore, levels=c("Decoy","Target"))
roc_hyper   <- roc(data$PSM_Type, data$Hyperscore, levels=c("Decoy","Target"))


roc_df <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(TPR=roc_rescore$sensitivities,
             FPR=1-roc_rescore$specificities,
             Score="Rescore"),

  data.frame(TPR=roc_hyper$sensitivities,
             FPR=1-roc_hyper$specificities,
             Score="Hyperscore")
)

p_roc <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(FPR, TPR, colour=Score)) +
  geom_line(size=1) +
  geom_abline(linetype="dashed") +
  labs(title="ROC Curve", x="False Positive Rate", y="True Positive Rate") +
  annotate("text", x=0.6, y=0.2,
           label=paste0(
             "Rescore = ", round(auc_rescore,3),
             "\nHyperscore = ", round(auc_hyperscore,3)
           )) +
    scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("Rescore" = "#E5C494", "Hyperscore" = "#66C2A5"),
    name   = "Score Type"
  ) +
  theme_foundation(base_size = base_size, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    panel.border      = element_blank(),
    panel.background  = element_blank(),  
    text              = element_text(colour = "black"),
    plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold",
                          size = rel((title_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size), hjust = 0.5),
    axis.line         = element_line(colour = "black", size = line_size),
    axis.ticks        = element_line(colour = "black", size = line_size),
    axis.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1)),
    axis.title.y      = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 2),
    axis.title.x      = element_text(vjust = -0.2),
    axis.text         = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black"),
    legend.title      = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = rel((axis_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size), colour = "black"),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey80"),
    plot.background   = element_blank(),
    legend.position   = c(0.95, 0.6),
    legend.justification = c(1, 1)
  )
p_roc


```

```{r}
    values = c("Rescore" = "#E5C494", "Hyperscore" = "#66C2A5"),
```

```{r}
data <- read.csv("rescoring_results_biotin_10ppm_final.csv")
data$Group <- "Rescore"

# ── Parameters ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
base_size          <- 12
axis_text_rel_size <- 2
title_text_rel_size <- 2
line_size          <- 0.5

# ── 1. Summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
summary_table <- data %>%
  group_by(PSM_Type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = n(),
    across(c(Rescore, Hyperscore),
           list(
             mean   = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
             median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
             sd     = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
             min    = ~min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
             max    = ~max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
           ),
           .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(summary_table)


# ── Separation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
separation <- summary_table %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Rescore_median_diff =
      Rescore_median[PSM_Type=="Target"] - Rescore_median[PSM_Type=="Decoy"],
    Hyperscore_median_diff =
      Hyperscore_median[PSM_Type=="Target"] - Hyperscore_median[PSM_Type=="Decoy"],

    Rescore_mean_diff =
      Rescore_mean[PSM_Type=="Target"] - Rescore_mean[PSM_Type=="Decoy"],
    Hyperscore_mean_diff =
      Hyperscore_mean[PSM_Type=="Target"] - Hyperscore_mean[PSM_Type=="Decoy"]
  )

print(separation)

# ── AUCs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
auc_rescore <- roc(data$PSM_Type, data$Rescore,
                   levels=c("Decoy","Target"), direction="<")$auc

auc_hyperscore <- roc(data$PSM_Type, data$Hyperscore,
                      levels=c("Decoy","Target"), direction="<")$auc


# ── ROC curves ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
roc_rescore <- roc(data$PSM_Type, data$Rescore, levels=c("Decoy","Target"))
roc_hyper   <- roc(data$PSM_Type, data$Hyperscore, levels=c("Decoy","Target"))


roc_df <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(TPR=roc_rescore$sensitivities,
             FPR=1-roc_rescore$specificities,
             Score="Rescore"),

  data.frame(TPR=roc_hyper$sensitivities,
             FPR=1-roc_hyper$specificities,
             Score="Hyperscore")
)

p_roc <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(FPR, TPR, colour=Score)) +
  geom_line(size=1) +
  geom_abline(linetype="dashed") +
  labs(title="ROC Curve", x="False Positive Rate", y="True Positive Rate") +
  annotate("text", x=0.6, y=0.2,
           label=paste0(
             "Rescore = ", round(auc_rescore,3),
             "\nHyperscore = ", round(auc_hyperscore,3)
           )) +
    scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("Rescore" = "#E5C494", "Hyperscore" = "#66C2A5"),

  ) +
  theme_foundation(base_size = base_size, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    panel.border      = element_blank(),
    panel.background  = element_blank(),  
    text              = element_text(colour = "black"),
    plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold",
                          size = rel((title_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size), hjust = 0.5),
    axis.line         = element_line(colour = "black", size = line_size),
    axis.ticks        = element_line(colour = "black", size = line_size),
    axis.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1)),
    axis.title.y      = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 2),
    axis.title.x      = element_text(vjust = -0.2),
    axis.text         = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black"),
    legend.title      = element_text(face = "bold"),
```

#Supplementary data - Bitoinylated peptide ion intensity distribution
```{r}
data <- read.csv(file = "Figure_6_cystein_rescore/rescoring_results.csv", header = TRUE)
graph_data <- data %>%
  filter(!grepl("Reverse", Protein)) %>%
  filter(
    grepl("463.23657", Parsed.Modifications)
  ) 

write.xlsx(graph_data, "Table_1_matched_ion_intensity_for_singly_labelled_AETMA_peptides.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

nrow(graph_data) # 122 peptides

#Intensity pie chart
intensity_cols <- c("b.matched.intensity", "y.matched.intensity", "a.matched.intensity",
                    "ModNL1.y.matched.intensity", "ModNL1.b.matched.intensity", "ModNL1.a.matched.intensity", "ModRM1.y.matched.intensity", "ModRM1.b.matched.intensity", "ModRM1.a.matched.intensity",
                     "ModRM1.MH.matched.intensity", "ModNL1.MH.matched.intensity", "MH.matched.intensity")

# Parse comma-separated intensity strings → row-wise sum
df_intensity <- graph_data %>%
  select(Peptide,Replicate, all_of(intensity_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(
    all_of(intensity_cols),
    ~ sapply(.x, function(val) {
      if (is.na(val) || val == "" || val == "0") return(0)
      sum(as.numeric(strsplit(as.character(val), ",")[[1]]), na.rm = TRUE)
    })
  ))

# Pivot to long, mirror the same labelling logic as ion_long
intensity_long <- df_intensity %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(intensity_cols), names_to = "ion_type", values_to = "intensity") %>%
  mutate(
    ion_type_clean = str_remove(ion_type, "\\.matched\\.intensity"),
    ion_base = case_when(
      str_ends(ion_type_clean, "b") ~ "b",
      str_ends(ion_type_clean, "y") ~ "y",
      str_ends(ion_type_clean, "a") ~ "a",
      str_ends(ion_type_clean, "MH") ~ "MH",
    ),
    is_neutral = str_starts(ion_type, "ModNL"),
    is_remainder = str_starts(ion_type, "ModRM"),
    ion_label = case_when(
      is_neutral ~ paste0("Remainder (+152.095 Da)"),
      is_remainder ~ paste0("Remainder (+180.101 Da)"),
      TRUE      ~ paste0("Intact Biotin")
    )
  )

# Sum intensities per peptide/group/replicate, then aggregate to mean across peptides
p_A2_data <- intensity_long %>%
  group_by(ion_base, ion_label, Replicate) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(sum_intensity = sum(intensity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(ion_base, ion_label) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_intensity = mean(sum_intensity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(ion_base) %>%        # <-- removed Group (not a column at this point)
  mutate(
    total     = sum(mean_intensity),
    pct       = mean_intensity / total * 100,
    pct_label = ifelse(pct >= 5, sprintf("%.1f%%", pct), "")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(                        # <-- added mutate( here
    ion_label = factor(ion_label, levels = c("Remainder (+152.095 Da)","Remainder (+180.101 Da)", "Intact Biotin"))
  )    


# Plot — pie charts faceted by ion_base
p_A2 <- p_A2_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = "", y = pct, fill = ion_label)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = pct_label),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3, fontface = "bold", colour = "black"
  ) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Ion type") +
  facet_wrap(~ion_base, ncol = 2,
             labeller = labeller(ion_base = c(b = "b-ions", y = "y-ions",
                                             a = "a-ions" , MH = "MH"))) +
  labs(
    title = "Relative Ion Intensity (%) of \n biotinylated peptides",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = NULL
  ) +
  theme_foundation(base_size = base_size, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    panel.border      = element_blank(),
    panel.background  = element_blank(),
    text              = element_text(colour = "black"),
    plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold",
                          size = rel((title_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size), hjust = 0.5),
    axis.line         = element_blank(),       # no axes on a pie
    axis.ticks        = element_blank(),
    axis.text         = element_blank(),       # hide angle labels
    plot.background   = element_blank(),
    strip.text        = element_text(face = "bold",
                          size = rel((title_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size), colour = "black"),
    strip.background  = element_blank(),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = rel((axis_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size), colour = "black"),
    legend.title      = element_text(face = "bold",
                          size = rel((axis_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size)),
    legend.position        = "bottom",         # bottom works better for pies
    legend.background      = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey80")
  )
p_A2

ggsave("Figure_2B_Bio_ion_intenstities_fragmentation.pdf",  p_A2, dpi = 600, width =14, height = 14,units="cm",device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
# ── 1. Calculate Replicate-Level Averages & % Difference ─────────────────────
replicate_summary <- data %>%
  group_by(Replicate, PSM_Type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    avg_hyperscore = mean(Hyperscore, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_rescore    = mean(Rescore, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Percentage Difference Formula: ((New - Old) / Old) * 100
    pct_diff = ((avg_rescore - avg_hyperscore) / avg_hyperscore) * 100
  )

# Calculate the overall mean improvement for the plot subtitle
mean_pct_gain <- mean(replicate_summary$pct_diff, na.rm = TRUE)

# ── 2. Reshape for Box Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_data_rep <- replicate_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(avg_hyperscore, avg_rescore),
    names_to = "Score_Type",
    values_to = "Mean_Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Score_Type = factor(Score_Type, 
                             levels = c("avg_hyperscore", "avg_rescore"),
                             labels = c("Hyperscore", "Rescore")))


pct_labels <- replicate_summary %>%
  group_by(PSM_Type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    # Find the average gain for this specific group (Target or Decoy)
    avg_pct = mean(pct_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Position the text above the highest data point in the facet
    y_pos = max(avg_rescore, avg_hyperscore, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ── 3. Create the Box Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_rep_box <- ggplot(plot_data_rep, aes(x = Score_Type, y = Mean_Value, fill = Score_Type)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
  
  # ADDED: Text labels for percentage difference inside each facet
  geom_text(
    data = pct_labels,
    aes(x = 1.5, y = y_pos, label = paste0("+", round(avg_pct, 1), "%")),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, # Prevent it from trying to use Score_Type for fill
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 5,
    color = "darkblue"
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Hyperscore" = "#4472C4", "Rescore" = "#E87B3E")) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Score Distribution by Replicate",
    subtitle = "Percentage values indicate mean gain from Rescoring",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean Score Value"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ PSM_Type, ncol = 2) +
  # Adjust y-axis slightly to make room for the label
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.2))) + 
  theme_foundation(base_size = base_size) + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2)),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.1)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(p_rep_box)
```

```{r}
data <- read.csv(file = "rescoring_results_5ppm.csv", header = TRUE)

get_q_curve_data <- function(df, score_col, label_name, Protein_filter = "AGH") {
  df %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(.data[[score_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      is_decoy   = PSM_Type == "Decoy",
      is_target  = PSM_Type == "Target",
      cum_decoy  = cumsum(is_decoy),
      cum_target = cumsum(is_target),
      # Using your specific 1.7 factor
      raw_FDR    = (cum_decoy + 1) / (cum_target)
    ) %>%
    mutate(q_value = rev(cummin(rev(raw_FDR)))) %>%
    # Filter for Targets and your specific Protein filter
    filter(PSM_Type == "Target", grepl(Protein_filter, Protein)) %>%
    # We only need the Q-value and the cumulative count
    mutate(PSM_Count = row_number(),
           Method = label_name) %>%
    dplyr::select(q_value, PSM_Count, Method)
}

# ── 1. Generate the data points ─────────────────────────────────────────────
curve_hyperscore <- get_q_curve_data(data, "Hyperscore", "Hyperscore")
curve_rescore    <- get_q_curve_data(data, "Rescore", "Rescore")
curve_morpheus    <- get_q_curve_data(data, "Morpheus_Score", "Morpheus_Score")
curve_length    <- get_q_curve_data(data, "Length_Dependent_Normalized_Score", "Length_Dependent_Normalized_Score")

# Combine for plotting
plot_q_data <- bind_rows(curve_hyperscore, curve_rescore,curve_morpheus, curve_length)

# ── 2. Create the Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_q_curve <- ggplot(plot_q_data, aes(x = q_value, y = PSM_Count, color = Method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  # Typically we focus on the 0% to 5% FDR range
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 0.05)) + 
  # Add a vertical line at the standard 1% FDR mark
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.01, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.011, y = max(plot_q_data$PSM_Count)*0.1, 
           label = "1% FDR", angle = 90, vjust = -0.5, color = "grey50") +
  labs(
    title = "Q-value Curve",
    x = "Q-value (FDR Threshold)",
    y = "Number of Target PSMs"
  ) +
  theme_foundation(base_size = base_size, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    panel.border      = element_blank(),
    panel.background  = element_blank(),
    text              = element_text(colour = "black"),
    plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold",
                          size = rel((title_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size), hjust = 0.5),
    axis.line         = element_line(colour = "black", size = line_size),
    axis.ticks        = element_line(colour = "black", size = line_size),
    axis.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1)),
    axis.title.y      = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 2),
    axis.title.x      = element_text(vjust = -0.2),
    axis.text         = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black"),
    legend.title      = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = rel((axis_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size), colour = "black"),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey80"),
    plot.background   = element_blank(),
    legend.position   = c(0.95, 0.99),
    legend.justification = c(1, 1)
  )
print(p_q_curve)
```
